name: Russia

seo.title: Russia Travel Guide: Moscow, St Petersburg, Kazan & More
seo.description: Explore Russia’s heritage cities: Moscow, Saint Petersburg, Kazan, Sochi and Vladimir-Suzdal. History, UNESCO sites, museums and itinerary ideas.
seo.h1: Russia Travel Guide: Heritage Cities and Cultural Highlights

heading: Russia Travel Guide: Heritage Cities and Cultural Highlights
description: Russia’s main visitor destinations combine imperial palaces, Orthodox churches, museums, theatre, medieval towns and Black Sea or mountain landscapes. This content set features Moscow, Saint Petersburg, Kazan, Sochi and Vladimir/Suzdal.
Moscow and Saint Petersburg should be the main international pages because they contain Russia’s strongest concentration of political, religious, artistic, imperial and architectural attractions.

Travel conditions, entry rules, flights, payments and government travel advisories for Russia can change quickly. Content on this site should describe heritage and attractions, and travellers should check the latest advice from their own government before planning.

quickFacts.Entry: Visa and entry rules depend on nationality and change; check official sources
quickFacts.Best time overall: May–September; Saint Petersburg’s White Nights run late May to mid-July

citiesSection.heading: Top Cities in Russia
citiesSection.body: Choose a city to see its main places to visit.

cities.name: Moscow
cities.intro: Moscow is Russia’s political and historical centre.
cities.knownFor: Kremlin, Red Square, St Basil’s, museums, theatre
cities.bestTime: May–September; winters are cold and snowy

cities.name: Saint Petersburg
cities.intro: Saint Petersburg was founded by Peter the Great in 1703 and served as Russia’s imperial capital for more than two centuries.
cities.knownFor: Hermitage, imperial palaces, canals, White Nights
cities.bestTime: June–August (White Nights); winter for snowy scenery

cities.name: Kazan
cities.intro: Kazan is the capital of Tatarstan and an important meeting point of Russian, Tatar, Islamic and Orthodox cultures.
cities.knownFor: Tatar and Russian culture, Kremlin, mosques, food

cities.name: Sochi
cities.intro: Sochi is a Black Sea resort city known for beaches, subtropical vegetation, mountains, wellness tourism and winter sports.
cities.knownFor: Black Sea beaches, Caucasus mountains, skiing, wellness
cities.bestTime: June–September for beaches; December–March for skiing

cities.name: Vladimir and Suzdal
cities.intro: Vladimir and Suzdal are historic cities of the Golden Ring, connected with medieval Russian state formation and Orthodox architecture.
cities.knownFor: Golden Ring towns, white-stone churches, wooden architecture
